description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' for logging purposes within an Android application. It provides static methods to log messages at various severity levels and manages a chain of LogNode objects to handle log message dispatching. Also defines logging level constants.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for logging messages at various severity levels, managing LogNode chain, and defining logging level constants.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Retrieves the current head LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will receive log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates log message to the chain of LogNodes if set.
